thread:
Tara (Billing): Heads-up: AcmeWorks called about missing promo applied retroactively. They expected a 3-month pilot promo but it wasn't reflected on invoices for Apr/May.
Ellen (Account Manager): They signed pilot agreement EX-AC-2026-03 with 100% promo for first 90 days. I sent the signed doc on 2026-03-20 to contracts.
Marcus (Finance): If promo was missed system-side, we should issue retro credits and attach promo metadata. Need invoice list and amounts.
Tara (Billing): Pulling invoices: INV-2026-0310 (Apr) $12,000 pre-promo, INV-2026-0420 (May) $13,500 pre-promo. Promo would be full offset for both months = $25,500.
Ellen (Account Manager): Customer understandably upset. They requested credit and a credit note for accounting.
Marcus (Finance): Approver required for >$10k. I approve retroactive promo credit for full amount as a one-time exception (partner/pilot). Memo: "retro promo credit per signed pilot EX-AC-2026-03; customer requested and validated by AM."
Tara (Billing): Creating credit batch: `billing-cli credit create --invoice INV-2026-0310 --amount 12000 --currency USD --reason "retro promo - pilot EX-AC-2026-03" --approver marcus_finance` and `billing-cli credit create --invoice INV-2026-0420 --amount 13500 --currency USD --reason "retro promo - pilot EX-AC-2026-03" --approver marcus_finance`
billing-bot: Credit requests submitted: CR-2026-17211 (INV-2026-0310) and CR-2026-17212 (INV-2026-0420) pending approval. Links: https://billing.internal/credits/CR-2026-17211 , https://billing.internal/credits/CR-2026-17212
Marcus (Finance): Approved both requests in system. Please ensure credit notes include reference to signed agreement EX-AC-2026-03 and attach the contract PDF to both credit records.
billing-bot: CR-2026-17211 APPROVED by marcus_finance at 2026-12-15T09:12:05Z. Credit applied: $12,000 to INV-2026-0310.
billing-bot: CR-2026-17212 APPROVED by marcus_finance at 2026-12-15T09:12:25Z. Credit applied: $13,500 to INV-2026-0420.
Tara (Billing): Notified AcmeWorks with credit notes and attached contract. Customer reply: "Thanks, all set for our accounting team."
Ellen (Account Manager): Filing a short postmortem with contracts: please confirm why signed doc wasn't flagged for promo ingestion. Tagging contracts and billing.
Marcus (Finance): I'll add these to year-end adjustments and run a sweep for other pilot agreements without redemptions.
Tara (Billing): Closing thread. Saved outreach copy and attached contract links to credit records.
